meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 44: HANDOFF 084 §3 [Agent] item 4 (does another provincial bureau publish a 年定报制度目录?) — answered YES for all three of Shandong, Jiangsu and Guangdong, and the answer opened NBS's own 统计制度 attachments
meta.note:
Round 44, Thomas's brief: 'check on Shandong/Jiangsu/Guangdong - lets finish up everything left in china'. RESULT: 12 nodes, 39 edges. THE ITEM-4 ANSWER IS YES FOR ALL THREE (recorded in the Guangdong _dropped note): Jiangsu's 统计制度 at /col/col85333/ is a fuller 年定报制度目录 than Shanghai's — 26 instruments for the 2025年报/2026定报 cycle, the whole instrument attached to each, plus the previous cycle; Guangdong splits national (/pc/) from local (/zxdc555/) survey projects and attaches the entire 一套表统计调查制度 as a 1.3MB .docx; Shandong's /col/col6112/ carries 14 of NBS's own 主要内容 summaries. Every cover read exactly as round 40 said it would.

BUT THE PROVINCIAL CATALOGUES ARE NOT WHERE THE ROUND WENT. Chasing 一套表统计调查制度 to its publisher led back to NBS's own 统计制度 listing, and there the seam was: EVERY ONE of its 24 instrument pages has a body of five characters — 具体内容见附件 — and the instrument itself hanging off it as an attachment that no round had ever opened. Those attachments carry, in a fixed house form, the three sentences this corpus wires on: 依照《中华人民共和国统计法》，制定本制度 (the legal basis), 本制度执行国民经济行业分类（GB/T 4754—2017）等统一的国家统计分类和编码标准 (the classification), and 统计资料的报送和公布, which names the publications the results are released through. Twelve of the corpus's NBS instrument nodes — minted across rounds 29-38 and every one of them with ZERO out-edges until today — were sitting one attachment away from their own basis.

WHY NOBODY HAD OPENED THEM, and it is a tooling answer, not a research one: the attachments are legacy binary Compound-File .doc served as application/msword. The fetcher read PDF, xlsx, docx and general zips, and a CFB file is none of those, so it fell through to the raw-text branch and graded empty. TWO ADDITIVE FETCHER BRANCHES, both narrow by construction and neither able to move an existing grade (checked: the corpus has two .doc URLs, both node `url` fields, zero evidence_url): (1) an archive carrying `word/document.xml` is read as docx whatever the ctype and URL say — NBS saves some of these as Word 2007+ under a .doc name; (2) a CFB body is converted with `soffice --headless --convert-to docx` and handed to the docx reader, the same defence round 42's .xls pass took, and the fourth branch of that shape.

FIVE PUBLICATION NODES GAINED A title_aliases ENTRY and the reason is a known trap, not a convenience: namesTarget strips ASCII parentheses before matching, so a node titled 'China Rural Statistical Yearbook (中国农村统计年鉴)' is invisible to a Chinese-only document naming it in full. cn-statistical-abstract has carried 中国统计摘要 as an alias since round 42 for exactly this. Added: 中国统计年鉴, 中国农村统计年鉴, 中国县域统计年鉴, 中国城市统计年鉴, 中国能源统计年鉴. The bilingual provincial yearbooks matched on their English titles, which is why this never bit before; NBS's instruments are Chinese-only.

TWO NODES CAME FROM PROVINCIAL PRINTINGS BECAUSE NBS PUBLISHES NO PAGE FOR THEM, on the round-40 precedent Thomas ruled: 一套表统计调查制度 (Guangdong's .docx; Jiangsu prints the identical document) and 农业产值与增加值核算统计报表制度 (Jiangsu's catalogue). Both covers read 国家统计局制定, both nodes carry the caveat. The second closes a title that had been on the nodeless list since round 30 and wires Jiangsu's chapter-10 citation.

TWO OLD LEADS RESOLVED: round 31's Xi'an mint-lead note (part 15's 《一套表统计调查制度》 is now wired; its part-12 《企业一套表统计调查制度》 and 《工业统计报表制度》 stay refused as different titles, and the note says so rather than being retagged, per the endpoint-free-note rule). The national yearbook's own sm16 sentence naming the integrated system — the single hit in the 211 documents round 43 saved — is wired too.

REFUSED, with reasons in the _dropped notes: four of the 24 listed instruments (their publication targets have no node), 劳动力调查制度's legal basis (国办发〔2004〕72号, not the Statistics Law directly), and Xi'an's two look-alike industry titles. Six NBS publications are named by sentences already read and stored and have no node — three citations for 《第三产业统计年鉴》, four for 《国家统计局主要统计信息发布日程表》 — each an immediate edge the moment its page is found; that list is the cheapest thing left in CN and it is recorded here rather than in HANDOFF.

reports.title: 一套表统计调查制度 (Integrated (One-Set-of-Forms) Statistical Survey System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS instrument behind China's 联网直报 'one set of forms' reporting — the single survey system that collects the annual and periodic returns of every above-threshold unit in industry, construction, wholesale and retail trade, accommodation and catering, real-estate development, services and other investing units, through one integrated form set filed directly to NBS's cloud reporting platform. It carries its own 分类目录 section, which is where the classification standards the whole above-threshold system runs on are bound into it. Reissued annually; the edition read here covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic returns, cover dated 2025年11月. ISSUER: the cover reads 国家统计局制定 with no provincial line, and 本制度由国家统计局负责解释 — this is an NBS instrument, read on a provincial publisher's copy under PLAYBOOK §7a's read-the-instrument-not-the-citation rule and rule 19's authorship-not-host principle. CAVEAT: NBS's own 统计制度 listing (24 instruments, article ids 1962929-1962952) does NOT carry it and no page for it was found on stats.gov.cn, so the URL is Guangdong's 国家统计调查项目 page, which publishes the whole instrument as a .docx; Jiangsu's 统计制度 catalogue publishes the identical document (art_85333_11737396) with the same cover. Minted round 44.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually for the following year's 年报/定报 cycle.

reports.title: 能源统计调查制度 (Energy Statistical Survey System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS survey system behind China's energy statistics: production, sales, stocks, purchases, consumption, processing and conversion, energy intensity and the energy balance. Its above-threshold content is collected inside the 一套表统计调查制度 and filed through the 统计云 direct-reporting system; provincial energy balance tables are compiled by each province and submitted to NBS for review. It is the instrument behind the energy chapters of the national yearbook and the Abstract, and behind the China Energy Statistical Yearbook. Reissued annually. The document read for this round is NBS's own attachment on that page — the instrument's 主要内容 (purpose, scope, content, method, organisation and where the results are published), attached as a legacy binary .doc that no grader run could read until this round's fetcher branch converted it. Minted round 44.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually; monthly and annual returns.
